scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:release && npm run test:acceptance && npm run test:emulators && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:acceptance: node scripts/prepare-acceptance.js && node tests/acceptance-isolation.test.mjs && node tests/smoke-runner.js --root=.acceptance-public --port=0
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --only firestore,functions --project demo-finance-web "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/firestore-rules.emulator.test.mjs tests/functions-emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --only firestore --project demo-finance-web "node --test tests/firestore-rules.emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --only functions --project demo-finance-web "node --test tests/functions-emulator.test.mjs"
